analysis: Reviewed the two supplied head_text units of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 806-1611). The only changed lines in the patch are in the sampling-defaults table near line 1841 and the following paragraph near lines 1864-1871, and those lines are outside the supplied units. The patch excerpt itself is documentation only. It says catalog Qwen 3.5/3.6 builds that ship no generation_config.json now take model-card defaults (temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, presence_penalty 1.5) via EngineV2SamplingDefaults.qwen35CardDefaults. That is a sampling-parameter change, not a security control change. No documented change touches the TB-002 coordinator-provider encryption, A-001 plaintext handling, T-041 prefix cache scoping or TTL, attestation, authorization or billing. The unchanged text in the supplied units covers GLM5Next, calibration, deadlines and prefix cache receipts, and none of it alters the T-041 posture (SSD tier, HMAC lookup tags, 30-minute TTL, coordinator-authored cacheSalt). The doc does not mention that sampling defaults enter the complete-checkpoint numerics fingerprint (PrefixCachePolicy.completeCheckpointIdentity). I cannot verify that from this evidence, so a prefix-cache reuse implication of the default change is unconfirmed. The actual code in EngineV2SamplingDefaults is not supplied, so I made no claim about the runtime behavior. Remaining question for integration: confirm that the code behind this doc change does not let a consumer-influenced field switch the card defaults, and that the cache identity still binds the sampling-relevant state. No finding qualifies.
